org: Department of Early Education and Care / Mass211
whatThisIs: Massachusetts, through EEC, offers financial assistance to help families pay for childcare. However, due to budget constraints, you will be added to a waitlist once you apply. If you need help applying or have questions not covered by EEC, Mass211 can help screen families for eligibility and locate childcare providers near you. The Application for Child Care Financial Assistance is run through EEC and can be completed online once you create an account. If accepted, you can then find a childcare provider who accepts the voucher and pay for childcare at a much lower cost, if at all.
whoItHelps: Families and parents looking for financial help with childcare.
whatToKnow: Due to waitlists, aid is not guaranteed on a set timeline. There is currently no released document sharing average waiting times.
Parents do not have to provide proof of citizenship to apply. Only the child must show documentation of citizenship or be a qualified non-citizen.
name: Child Care Financial Assistance
